overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Reserve Edition 3-Person Full Spectrum Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Sauna with Himalayan Salt Bar offers a premium wellness retreat right in your home. Designed for relaxation and rejuvenation, this sauna features 8 advanced heaters, including PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR IR carbon panels, ensuring a safe and soothing heat experience. Crafted from natural Canadian Hemlock wood, it combines elegance with functionality, enhanced by chromotherapy lighting and Himalayan salt bars for added health benefits like stress relief and improved circulation. Ideal for indoor spaces such as basements or fitness rooms, this sauna also boasts a touch screen control panel with Bluetooth connectivity, making it a perfect blend of luxury and technology.
